summary: Independent complete review of 136 finished with changes-requested. Q1-RA-010 is resolved: Action-result physical requiredness now uses top-level runStatus + context.action and is shared by terminal preflight and C1 Reader admission. Q1-RA-007 is materially improved at terminal completion: revise-* source-review requiredness is Action-owned, matching review stage is enforced, and both admitted/persisted verdicts must be changes-requested. However the Reader applies the completed source-review tuple rule to pending revise Runs as well. A legitimate pending revise has sourceReviewRun/sourceReviewVerdict in context but has no terminal actionResult.reviewVerdictRef yet; validateImmutableRunResultRefs still passes requiresTuple=true and validateSourceReviewTuple therefore reports missing-reviewVerdictRef, so the bounded revision-window state itself produces a FactConflict. Conversely immutable source-review validation currently returns conflicts only; readFormalFactSnapshot then passes the same unfiltered runs array into artifact/verification generation classification. A completed revise with an invalid/missing/tampered reviewVerdictRef can therefore still be treated as a successor based only on sourceReviewRun/sourceReviewVerdict plus an admitted review, relaxing predecessor mutable validation even though that successor's immutable source-review evidence failed. This violates the approved two-stage Reader boundary: first validate immutable Run/review-revise lineage, then classify generations. 136 is formally present and exact-binds 135. Author-recorded typecheck/lint/build/584 tests/OpenSpec/diff checks are accepted as recorded. Delivery Full Test was not authorized or run.

blockingFindings.title: Reader source-review lineage validation is not status-aware and is not an admission boundary for generation classification
blockingFindings.location: src/facts/formal-fact-reader.ts: readFormalFactSnapshot, readC1Run, validateImmutableRunResultRefs, validateGenerationAwareArtifacts, validateVerificationGenerationAware; src/persistence/result-ref-adapter.ts: validateSourceReviewTuple; src/facts/generation-resolver.ts
blockingFindings.evidence: A pending schemaVersion 2 revise Run has no result.json and therefore no actionResult.reviewVerdictRef. readC1Run still projects sourceReviewRun/sourceReviewVerdict from context into the pending RunFact. validateImmutableRunResultRefs then calls validateSourceReviewTuple for every Run and sets requiresTuple=true solely because action is revise-explore/revise-propose/revise-apply. Because the pending Run has sourceReviewRun/sourceReviewVerdict but no terminal reviewVerdictRef, the shared tuple validator reports missing-reviewVerdictRef. This makes a legitimate pending revise revision window conflict, despite the approved design explicitly allowing pending revise-S to open the bounded revision window. In the opposite direction, validateImmutableRunResultRefs returns FactConflict[] only and does not identify which revise Runs are lineage-admitted. readFormalFactSnapshot subsequently passes the original runs array to generation-aware artifact and verification validation. classifyArtifactGenerations / classifyVerificationGenerations establish successor lineage from sourceReviewRun/sourceReviewVerdict and admitted review facts, but do not know whether the completed successor's reviewVerdictRef failed immutable tuple validation. Thus a completed revise with missing/wrong/hash-mismatched reviewVerdictRef can still influence generation classification and cause the predecessor to be treated as superseded/revision-window while a source-review conflict is reported separately.
blockingFindings.impact: The Reader fails in both directions around the same boundary: a legal pending revision window becomes conflicting before its terminal-only evidence can exist, while an invalid completed successor can still influence classification after its immutable lineage evidence failed. This weakens deterministic recovery and can suppress the predecessor's current mutable-byte validation. The presence of some other conflict does not satisfy the approved two-stage contract that generation classification must be based on validated review/revise lineage.
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Make Reader source-review lineage validation status-aware and make successful lineage validation an actual eligibility boundary for generation classification. A legitimate pending revise must be able to prove its context-level predecessor review lineage without requiring a terminal-only reviewVerdictRef; a completed revise must prove the full immutable source-review evidence required at terminal time. Only revise Runs whose applicable lineage evidence has passed the Reader's validation may open revision-window/superseded generation semantics. Preserve matching review stage, changes-requested-only semantics, exact review admission, and immutable strictness for completed historical Runs. The Author may choose any implementation structure that establishes these outcomes.
acceptance: A legitimate pending revise-explore/revise-propose/revise-apply sourced from the matching admitted changes-requested review produces no source-review missing-reviewVerdictRef conflict solely because result.json does not exist yet.
That legitimate pending revise still opens the intended bounded revision window.
Pending revise with missing/wrong-stage/approved/unadmitted context lineage fails closed.
Completed revise still requires and validates the full source-review tuple including reviewVerdictRef target/kind/hash.
A completed revise whose full source-review evidence is invalid is not eligible to supersede a predecessor or verification generation.
A test demonstrates that an invalid completed successor cannot hide a predecessor artifact/verification replacement conflict by causing it to be classified superseded.

resolvedPriorFindings.evidence: validateActionResultApplicability now receives top-level runStatus; completed artifact-producing results structurally require producedResultRefs and completed review-apply requires verificationSummaryRef regardless of actionResult.executionStatus. The same applicability validator is used in terminal preflight and admitC1RunResult.
Review inputRef requiredness and shared validateReviewRunBinding remain exact across terminal preflight, Reader, and sibling lineage.
Raw terminal publisher remains private; completeRun remains descriptor-driven.
Shared stage effective-set validation remains in preflight/review-entry/current Reader validation.
Run-ID and produced-artifact descriptor boundaries remain runtime closed.
Non-Run logical/archive resolver remains absolute/traversal/exact-archive fail-closed.
Current verificationSummaryRef recovery remains presence/kind/path/target/hash fail-closed.
